title: Number of Beautiful Integers in the Range
summary: Given positive integers low, high, and k, count the numbers in the range [low, high] that have an equal number of even and odd digits and are divisible by k.
statement: Given positive integers low, high, and k, count the numbers in the range [low, high] that have an equal number of even and odd digits and are divisible by k.
constraints: A beautiful integer has equal counts of even and odd digits and is divisible by k.
hints: Count qualifying values up to a bound, then subtract the prefix below low.
Digit DP tracks position, even-minus-odd balance, remainder, tightness, and whether a nonleading digit started.
Try each allowed next digit and accept started states with balance and remainder zero.
Those states retain exactly the information future digits need, so every bounded integer is counted once.
